title: Find an item on USFans Findsheet
body: Open Spreadsheet, choose a category and open a product. Compare its photos and USD estimate, then use Buy on USFans to continue to the matching listing.
alt: Actual USFans Findsheet product page showing its Buy on USFans button and dollar price
caption: Actual Findsheet product page · captured 16 November 2026

title: Create or sign in to your USFans account
body: The official registration screen asks for an email and password. An invitation code is optional. Read the platform agreements yourself before creating an account, or sign in if you already have one.
alt: Actual USFans registration page with email, password and optional invitation code fields
caption: Actual USFans registration screen · no account was created for this tutorial

title: Choose the exact style, size and quantity
body: On USFans, choose the seller’s options and inspect the displayed USD total. The screenshot shows a real size selection for the example listing. The lowest spreadsheet estimate may differ from the variant you select.
alt: Actual USFans product page after selecting EUR42 size, showing variant choices and USD price
caption: Actual USFans product interaction · example only, not a size recommendation

title: Review the order and item payment
body: Check the selected item, quantity and local delivery charge before paying. This official tutorial screenshot shows the order-review stage; it is not an order placed by this site. Follow the current payment options in your account.
alt: Official USFans tutorial screenshot showing order review, domestic freight and the Submit button
caption: USFans official beginner-guide screenshot · illustrative amounts may differ from your order

title: Check the warehouse photos before shipping
body: After arrival, review your own item in USFans Warehouse. Compare its colour, labels, measurements and visible condition with your selected listing. Public QC shown on Findsheet is research material, not proof of your individual order. Check after-sales options promptly if there is a problem.
alt: Findsheet detail page distinguishing USFans public QC and main-site QC from product listing images
caption: Findsheet public QC entry points; personal warehouse screens require your own signed-in account
cta: Read the QC and returns FAQ

title: Submit a parcel and review the shipping quote
body: In Warehouse, select eligible items and follow the parcel instructions. Confirm the destination, packing choices and available route. The official tutorial shows that international shipping is a later payment stage; review the current quote before continuing.
alt: Official USFans tutorial screenshot of international shipping payment and parcel charges
caption: USFans official shipping-step screenshot · available routes and charges depend on your parcel

title: Track the parcel and check delivery
body: Use Parcels in your USFans account to follow shipment progress. Keep the tracking reference and check the parcel when it arrives. If something needs attention, use the official parcel after-sales options rather than assuming this directory can resolve an order.
alt: Official USFans tutorial screenshot showing parcel tracking and shipping progress
caption: USFans official tracking screenshot · delivery timing is specific to your shipment
